What’s new

Find out what is new in Event Endpoint Management version 11.1.x.

Release 11.1.5

Produce events

Event Endpoint Management version 11.1.5 introduces the ability for client applications to write events to an event endpoint through the Event Gateway. Kafka administrators can manage these connections with schema enforcement and approval controls.

Security and bug fixes

Event Endpoint Management release 11.1.5 contains security and bug fixes.

Release 11.1.4

Updates to publish options

Event Endpoint Management 11.1.4 introduces a user interface update for publishing options. For more information, see Creating an option and Publishing options.

Support for Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 4.15

Event Endpoint Management version 11.1.4 introduces support for Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 4.15.

Support for Kubernetes 1.29

Event Endpoint Management version 11.1.4 introduces support for Kubernetes platforms version 1.29 that support the Red Hat Universal Base Images (UBI) containers.

Security and bug fixes

Event Endpoint Management release 11.1.4 contains security and bug fixes.

Documentation: Highlighting differences between versions

Any difference in features or behavior introduced by Event Endpoint Management 11.1.4 compared to 11.1.3 or earlier is highlighted in this documentation by using the following graphic:

Release 11.1.3

Support for Linux on IBM Z

In addition to Linux 64-bit (x86_64) systems, Event Endpoint Management 11.1.3 and later is also supported on OpenShift deployments running on Linux on IBM Z systems (s390x).

Note: You cannot install Event Endpoint Management on other Kubernetes platforms except OpenShift when running on IBM Z systems.

Documentation: Highlighting differences between versions

Any difference in features or behavior introduced by Event Endpoint Management 11.1.3 compared to 11.1.2 or earlier is highlighted in this documentation by using the following graphic:

Security and bug fixes

Event Endpoint Management release 11.1.3 contains security and bug fixes.

Release 11.1.2

New controls for options

Event Endpoint Management release 11.1.2 introduces two new controls for options.

  • Redaction: A redaction control enables you to hide personal information (PI).
  • Schema filtering: The schema filtering control ensures consistency by replacing any messages that do not match the schema that is provided in the topic with a null message.

Support for exporting as AsyncAPI 3.0

Event Endpoint Management release 11.1.2 introduces support for exporting AsyncAPI 3.0 specification documents for your event sources and event endpoints published in the catalog. You can also export these in AsyncAPI 2.6 and 2.1 format. For more information, see exporting topic details.

Documentation: Highlighting differences between versions

Any difference in features or behavior introduced by Event Endpoint Management 11.1.2 compared to 11.1.1 or earlier is highlighted in this documentation by using the following graphic:

Security and bug fixes

Event Endpoint Management release 11.1.2 contains security and bug fixes.

Release 11.1.1

Options for topics

Event Endpoint Management release 11.1.1 introduces options. Kafka administrators can create options for a topic, which enables administrators to control how the topic’s stream of events are made available within the catalog.

Approval control

Event Endpoint Management release 11.1.1 introduces approval control. Now you can control who can subscribe to your topics. For more information, see approval controls for options and subscription approvals.

Documentation: Highlighting differences between versions

Any difference in features or behavior introduced by Event Endpoint Management 11.1.1 compared to 11.1.0 or earlier is highlighted in this documentation by using the following graphic:

Security and bug fixes

Event Endpoint Management release 11.1.1 contains security and bug fixes.

Release 11.1.0

Event Endpoint Management Admin API

Event Endpoint Management release 11.1.0 introduces the Event Endpoint Management Admin API for accessing Event Endpoint Management features programmatically. Access to the Admin API is controlled by tokens.

Support for IBM API Connect in non-IBM Cloud Pak for Integration deployments

Event Endpoint Management release 11.1.0 can be integrated with IBM API Connect 10.0.7 and later without requiring an IBM Cloud Pak for Integration deployment.

Support for Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 4.14

Event Endpoint Management 11.1.0 introduces support for Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 4.14.

Security and bug fixes

Event Endpoint Management release 11.1.0 contains security and bug fixes.
